summary: Wave C actors package. (1) visuals-chase-front-not-brightest, actors part: RetractionView.DrawGlint now draws the glint at a constant 0.5 u half size (the agreed cross-package value), with a steady 15 Hz flicker between 0.8 and 1.0 opacity (floor 0.7, was 0.25 on about 35 % of the steps). A soft halo goes under it: the shared Halo shape id, 1.2 u half size, opacity 0.35, front color, its glow peaking just outside the bulb. Both are in the overlay batch (queue 3004), above droplets, pearls and the composite that draws the threads. The fire and electric overlays get the unchanged glint parameters (0.22, 0.3, 0.08). The liquid overlay's shape 3 is a plain Gaussian core, so the liquid front gets a wider core (0.4, 0.36, 0.1). (2) feel-08: the home chevron keeps a constant screen size. Its half size is 0.62 u x ViewScale and its distance from the pearl rim is 0.65 u x ViewScale; ViewScale is the new ActorContext.ViewScale, read from CameraRig.Current.ViewScale with a fallback of 1. It is drawn in three layers: a halo disc in the human color (alpha 0.45, 1.3x the chevron half size), a navy drop shadow offset (0.05, -0.05) u x ViewScale at alpha 0.6, then the chevron. The chevron is off-white (linear 0.78, about sRGB 229) instead of pure white, so it does not add luma >= 235 pixels next to the pearl; that keeps the spark the brightest moving thing (contract 25.5) and lets both acceptance checks pass together. Results on Build/actors (540x960, -quality medium, CutDroplets): liquid front/pearl bright pixels 51/28 = 1.82x (was 11/116 = 0.09x on the Gate B build), fire 52/30 = 1.73x (was 1.13x), electric 314/337 = 0.93x. In electric, ElectricOverlay's chevron multiplies the albedo by 1.15 to 1.4 and turns it white, so it adds 195 bright pixels on its own; without the chevron the ratio is 2.21x. That fix is listed under needs. The liquid chevron now spans 21x21 px (15x16 px before, same measurement). Probe hash 246577239DE179C4 unchanged (ProbeResult PASS). EditMode: 21/21 actor tests green; full suite 486 tests, 483 passing, 2 skipped, 1 failing in the fire package's own test file. PlayMode BootTests 4/4.

It passes at 2.21x without the chevron. Needs the electric chevron cap below, then a re-measure at the gate.

Fire and electric numbers were taken on a build that contained those packages' work in progress (built 16:36). The gate should re-run docs/waveC/actors/tools/measure.py on the final build: python measure.py <devshot dir> <biome> <tag> [crop dir].

The plan says 'the white chevron'. The chevron is off-white (linear 0.78, about sRGB 229) so that only the spark reaches luma >= 235 near the pearl; at the Gate B size the pure white chevron alone gave about 60 such pixels. If the user prefers pure white, the luma acceptance must exclude the chevron area.

needs: biome-electric-liquid (Assets/Resources/Shaders/ElectricOverlay.hlsl, shape 2 Chevron): do not raise the fill above the view's albedo. Today fill = lerp(albedo, cool, 0.25) * (1.15 to 1.4) turns the actors' off-white home chevron (linear 0.78) into white, which puts 195 luma >= 235 pixels within 1.5 u of the human pearl at 540x960. Suggested: drop the 1.15 to 1.4 factor or clamp the fill to at most 0.8 linear, keeping the cool tint, outline and glow. The spark then stays the brightest moving thing (front/pearl measured at 2.21x without the chevron).
